calculationFlow: - Content acquisition (sports rights, originals, syndication): ₹6,000-10,000 Cr (e.g., IPL rights ₹6,500 Cr/year).
- Tech infrastructure (CDN, cloud, encoding, app dev): ₹600-900 Cr.
For JioHotstar (post-merger, owns IPL + ICC rights + Disney library): ~₹14-16K Cr cost.
Result: thin profitability or loss until subscriber + ad scale grows.
